observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan (2355 x 2455) blurred 3x3, whole with a 0.05 grid and three crops at 0.02; read for the shell's shape, not against a render; the cabinet's face is left to its own tracing
covers: behind and around the 0096-9M2 cabinet: the lining and the wall's upper strip, the pylon's drum and foot, the floor at the cabinet's foot, the sloped gauge sheet and the low table and panels seen past the cabinet
notes: session A (9A33BM2/BM3, not identified). The camera is a little left of the cabinet's face. The cabinet stands here with the racks and left wall beyond it to the photo's right; how this fits with the bare bulkhead of g099-a and g100-c, where no cabinet appears, is unresolved. A hangar-session reading of the cabinet is g096-a d56 (cross-session).

details.what: the lining at the top right, soft padded cloth, darker lower
a darker sloping band of lining dropping to the rack's top, rising to the photo's right
the left wall's upper strip above the racks, a straight dark ledge
the rack's foot: a long dark shelf line running along the wall below the racks, a thin bracket standing on it
details.note: probably g099-d d02 or g099-b d09

details.what: the floor past the cabinet at the left of the far seats: a plain dull grey, no plate edges legible
a low shelf or sheet table beyond the cabinet, a rail-rounded grey box with a U-shaped tube above it (a short mention)
the tall grey sheet leaning at the left wall's foot, a blue line behind its top, its lit edge up the near side
a light sheet running low from under the cabinet to the right, its upper edge a straight line, then a dark gap to the gauge sheet
the pylon's body at the frame's left, a big vertical drum, smooth and plain, standing clear of the cabinet
details.note: the same drum as g099-d d15, on the evidence of its size and foot flange (medium confidence); catalogue names it the pylon

details.what: a bent tube strut from the drum down to the floor, curving at its foot
details.size_cue: about as thick as a cannon plug's cable

details.what: bolts round the drum's foot flange
the drum's flared foot ring, its edge curving down to the floor plate
two parallel dark bars low on the floor between the box and the cabinet's plugs, a flange or a sill
a bright flashing or sheet-metal edge at the floor below the bars, curved
a grey sheet box standing on the floor at the frame's bottom left
the cabinet whole (a mention only, tall box hanging over the floor with six plugs below it, its foot clear of the floor)
